A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Sakiyan''' served a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] as an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] worker along with two other [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoids]] and a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]]. She sat beside the Hutt with one of the humanoids whilst he met with another Hutt and their slaves. The [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] had [[Color/Legends|black]] skin, and no [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="TEA" /> as was common for her [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>. On at least one occasion, she wore a Gold neck piece and arm [[Bracelet/Legends|bracelet]] along with a white skirt.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sakiyan first appeared in a picture illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] for the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The picture that contained the Sakiyan was used in the book to illustrate Hutts and the various enslaved species of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] which served them.
